lead: I build server-side systems with the discipline of someone who draws the architecture first. My work at Planeta IP Comunicaciones SAS ESP centers on C# / ASP.NET services backed by PostgreSQL and Dapper, with RBAC and JWT auth, structured around Clean Architecture boundaries. I treat AI-assisted workflows — Claude Code, Codex — as first-class engineering tools: faster iteration, but the review standard stays human.
tagline: Backend systems, drawn before they're built.

bullets: End-to-end backend ownership: PostgreSQL schema design and migrations, API development, integrations, and production readiness.
Implemented a versioned ASP.NET Core REST API with exception middleware, response standardization, and rate limiting.
Built cookie-based JWT auth with refresh-token rotation and hashing, plus RBAC with hierarchical policies.
Performance-focused data layer with Dapper (parameterized SQL, paging/search, CTE reporting) and transactional workflows via Unit of Work.
Refactored PostgreSQL stored functions from hardcoded implementations to dynamic, parameterized versions with layered validation for an emergency-management system.
Integrated AI-assisted development workflows (Claude Code, Codex) into daily engineering: architecture planning, code review, and PostgreSQL function design.

notes: Intensive program focused on C#, ASP.NET, PostgreSQL, and software architecture.

entries.title: Drawings first
entries.body: Domain and use-case diagrams precede code. Clean Architecture contracts keep boundaries honest so the codebase stays tractable as it grows.

entries.title: AI-paired, human-reviewed
entries.body: Claude Code and Codex act as accelerators and first reviewers. Every diff still passes a manual read and the test gate before it merges.

entries.title: Proof by tests
entries.body: Vitest and Playwright on the web surface; xUnit patterns on backend work. If it matters enough to ship, it matters enough to pin down with a test.
